snippet.title: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel - Early Access Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The adventure begins in Early Access!

Join Fluff, a furry little hero on a mission to save its island from a robot invasion in Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel, a third-person puzzle platformer built around exploration and color-based puzzles.

Explore an atmospheric island alone or in two-player splitscreen co-op, discover other Fluffs and switch between your new friends to use their different colors to solve tricky puzzles. Search for secrets and collectibles, customize your Fluff with accessories and uncover the strange mysteries hidden across the island.

Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is available now in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989700/Fluffs_Adventure_A_Tale_of_Fur_and_Steel/
